title: Categorical Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1, and related CEQA findings;…
text:
[Council File 26-1193; CD 13]
Categorical Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class 1, and related CEQA findings; report from the Department of City Planning (DCP); and an appeal filed by Emerson College (Los Angeles) (Representative: Paola M. Ferrer, Emerson College), from the determination of DCP in approving a Modification of Entitlements to modify Conditions of Approval Nos. 1 and 7.e; for the construction, use and maintenance of a new seven-story, 102,224 square-foot mixed-use building with 109 dwelling units (including 14 units – 15% of the base density set aside for Very Low Income Households), and 14,657 square feet of ground floor commercial space with a proposed building height of 86 feet and a total of 196 automobile parking spaces within one subterranean and three above ground level of parking and a total of 148 bicycle spaces; for the property located at 6007 West Sunset Boulevard (6001 - 6023 West Sunset Boulevard; 1503 - 1517 North Gordon Street; and 1506 - 1512 North La Baig Avenue), subject to Conditions of Approval; and adoption of project findings.
Applicant: 6007 Sunset (LA) OZ, LLC
Representative: Chris Manasserian, Gonzales Law Group, APC
Case No. CPC-2021-1557-DB-SPR-HCA-M1-1A
Environmental No. ENV-2026-2496-CE
Related Case Nos. CPC-2021-1557-DB-SPR-HCA-M1; CPC-2021-1557-DB-SPR-HCA
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - OCTOBER 24, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - OCTOBER 23, 2026)
